N1.s: Umetumia cutling zote %lld za bure. Endelea kwenye Cutling ufungue toleo kamili, na cutling hii itahifadhiwa.
N1.back: You-have-used cutling all 5 of free. Continue in Cutling you-unlock version full, and cutling this will-be-saved.
N1.why: Opens with S3's own words; Endelea is the vocab's continue word, matching the system's continue-in-app choice, and 'toleo kamili' (full version) pairs with S28's 'toleo la bure' so fungua cannot read as 'open'.

N2.s: Umetumia cutling zote %lld za bure. Fungua toleo kamili kwenye Cutling uhifadhi zaidi.
N2.back: You-have-used cutling all 5 of free. Unlock version full in Cutling you-save more.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1; the bare subjunctive uhifadhi after the command carries 'so you can save more' without ili, which keeps it under 90.

N3.why: 'Bado moja' is the spoken 'one more left'; nafasi is the slot word from S6 and K1, and 'za bure' is dropped to fit 30, since the capsule only ever shows on a free copy.

N4.why: The compact pair from M4 with zimejaa, K1's word for full; the class-10 zi- takes nafasi as its subject, and 'kati ya' would run past 30.

N5.why: Starts like K1 (Nafasi … zimejaa); the object marker -i- in uihifadhi points to the item being saved, so the line promises it is kept; 40 characters.

N6.why: The verb from S14 and S15, alone as a button; it sits where Hifadhi usually is, so the swap reads as unlock, not open.

N7.s: Umetumia cutling zote %lld za bure. Ukifungua Cutling, hii itahifadhiwa.
N7.back: You-have-used cutling all 5 of free. If-you-unlock Cutling, this will-be-saved.
N7.why: Conditional uki- as in S28's 'Ukifungua Cutling'; 'hii' stands for the item shown in the form below, so cutling is not said twice.

N8.s: Imewekwa kando kwa ajili yako. Nenda kwenye Cutling ufungue, na itahifadhiwa.
N8.back: It-has-been-put aside for sake your. Go to Cutling you-unlock, and it-will-be-saved.
N8.why: 'Imewekwa kando' (set aside) says kept without imehifadhiwa, which would claim it is already saved; 'nenda kwenye' does the opening so fungua is left to mean unlock.
